jobs.description: HOBIJHOBIJ  Share on  Back to overview Operator A - € 17,00 - € 19,00 - Zinkunie - Boxtel Introduction Do you enjoy working with machines and are you accurate? At Zinkunie in Boxtel, you make metal products for roofs and facades. You work in 2 shifts, receive a 20% shift allowance and join a practical team where quality and teamwork are important. What are you going to do? As an operator, you work with different machines for beading, cutting and bending sheet metal. You set up the machines correctly, place the material in the machine and check the finished product. You work with work orders, drawings and clear work instructions. Your tasks include: - Setting up and operating machines - Beading, cutting and bending sheet metal - Checking products for size, quantity and damage - Working with tape measure and, when needed, an angle gauge - Moving products to the next workstation - Packing products and preparing them for storage - Identifying small machine problems and solving them when possible - Carrying out small daily maintenance tasks - Keeping your workplace clean, tidy and safe The work can be repetitive. This job is therefore a good fit for someone who enjoys practical production work and does not mind doing the same tasks often. When needed, you may also use a forklift to move materials within the production area.  What are the working hours? You work in a 2-shift system: - From 06:00 - 14:00 - From 14:00 - 22:00  Who are you?  - You are motivated and enjoy practical production work - You do not mind repetitive work - You work accurately and pay attention to quality - You are willing to work in 2 shifts - You speak English at minimum B2 level - Experience in production or working with machines is a plus  What do you get? At Zinkunie, you will earn a gross hourly wage between €16.55 and €20.23, depending on your experience. Your salary is paid out weekly on Friday. And that's not all. - 20% shift allowance on top of you...

Senior Visual Designer Full-time / Part-time · Utrecht  Join our team CLEVER°FRANKE is an enthusiastic, multi-disciplinary team of 40+ people with 15 different nationalities from across the world and we use English as a primary language to communicate and collaborate. We are interaction designers, visual designers, developers, project managers, data analysts and others. All with a passion for what we do. We are curious about the world around us and apply the same curiosity to our work and projects. We have been growing and we are looking for an experienced Visual Designer who brings creative energy, taste, curiosity, and who can turn complex topics into work that is distinctive and precise. As a Senior Visual Designer , you set the visual direction of our projects and refine it in detail over multiple iterations. Our projects span a wide range, including products, dashboards, (physical) data experiences, design systems, AI interfaces and brand identities. What they have in common is that they often deal with uncommon, complex topics and have data as a central component. In your role, you get up to speed quickly and translate these topics into compelling visuals. Much of this work happens inside an existing corporate identity, and the craft is in producing something unmistakably yours within those limits. Projects range from short concept sprints to extended, complex, and iterative programs, and as a visual designer, you are involved from start to finish.
